deal_value.notes: All-cash $20.00 per share; ~US$2.0B enterprise value; ~26% premium to the Aug 8, 2025 close. Includes minority co-investment from Silversmith Capital Partners. Completed Oct 24, 2025. $1.4B private-credit financing package.

calculable.calculation: $2,000M EV / $316.3M FY2024 GAAP revenue = 6.32x; $2,000M EV / $130.7M FY2024 adjusted EBITDA = 15.3x
inputs: FY2024 revenue $316.3M and FY2024 adjusted EBITDA $130.7M (41% margin) - MeridianLink Q4/FY2024 earnings release: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250306116917/en/MeridianLink-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-Year-2024-Results
calculable.caveats: Multiples computed on FY2024 actuals (last full year pre-announcement). A forward multiple on 2025 guidance would differ; definitive proxy/merger docs would allow a fully diluted EV cross-check.

notes: Hint re co-party 'Bridgeport': no entity named Bridgeport appears in any deal coverage; the disclosed minority co-investor is Silversmith Capital Partners - 'Bridgeport' in the source list appears to be an error. A Medium blog post claims a '10x 2025 EBITDA' entry multiple, but that is arithmetically inconsistent ($2.0B EV / $132-138M 2025 EBITDA guidance = ~14.5-15.2x) and Medium is not a credible source, so ev_multiple is treated as not published.
